territory: Failure mining: systematic error-case discovery, hard-example selection, slice discovery, and error-taxonomy-driven training and evaluation for vision models (segmentation/detection/classification on images and video)
schema_notes: Each JSONL line carries the parent-mandated fields (candidate_id, territory, title, one_line_idea, cluster, problem, core_hypothesis, falsifiable_prediction, why_important, why_possibly_novel, minimal_falsification_experiment, main_risk, community_default_belief, why_it_might_be_wrong, fastest_falsifying_experiment, evidence_label) plus the task_queue shard_format aliases (core_claim, method_sketch, novelty_hook, kill_risk) mirroring their counterparts, consistent with sibling shards genA-01..03. Every candidate states the community default belief, why it might be wrong, and a cheapest falsifying experiment.

compliance.scope: All 90 candidates are academic vision/ML research on segmentation/detection/classification error analysis for images and video; no security, intrusion, or reverse-engineering content.
compliance.forbid_fiction: No fabricated papers, citations, benchmark numbers, dataset facts, or claimed experimental results; all quantitative statements are phrased as falsifiable predictions under HYPOTHESIS or MODEL SPECULATION labels.
compliance.novelty_claims: All novelty statements are hedged as possibly-novel and explicitly marked unverified; no verified novelty claimed.
compliance.protected_files: window.lock.json, research_state.json, ideas_master.jsonl untouched; no Windows directories created; no Windows numbers changed; only the two listed output files written.

unresolved_items: Novelty of all 90 candidates is unverified against the literature; Wave B dedup plus any novelty-checking stage must vet before promotion.

Intra-shard conceptual neighbors flagged for dedup review: errc-0009 vs errc-0081 vs errc-0082 (slice stability/multiplicity control family), errc-0005 vs errc-0018 vs errc-0073 (label-noise contamination of mined errors family), errc-0066 vs errc-0069 (input-intrinsic difficulty decomposition family), errc-0046 vs errc-0063 vs errc-0085 (annotator-ambiguity irreducible-error family), errc-0002 vs errc-0016 (VLM-generated description audit family).

Cross-territory overlap likely with genA-07 (benchmark weaknesses) via the benchmark_construction_from_errors cluster, and with any uncertainty/calibration shard via error_prediction_models; dedup should treat those clusters as high-collision zones.
Several candidates (errc-0073, errc-0075, errc-0083) require human-subjects-style annotation studies whose cost/IRB-equivalent feasibility should be assessed before promotion.
